name: model-guard
description: Persistent Codex CLI band for model routing, passive 516 reasoning anomalies, account identity and usage.

interface.shortDescription: Watch model routing, 516 reasoning anomalies and your Codex account.
interface.longDescription: A persistent terminal band using the official Codex CLI. Displays model routing, account and passive reasoning-token signals. Repeated 516 hits produce a heuristic warning; missing model disclosure stays unverified. Includes reversible setup and diagnostics.
defaultPrompt: Set up Model Guard for my Codex CLI.
